about: In-game checks of the combat simulator: each scenario is a build seeded as a GM character (combat-sim.py seed-scenarios) and a monster spawned with /mon <row> 1. Scenarios 1-4 use monsters whose AI casts no skill and summons nothing while fighting (death-only summons are fine); 5-6 check the monster AI: skills cast from the 'damaged' pattern.

scenarios.title: Champion melee: normal attacks, refine and gem
scenarios.play: Auto-attack only. No skills, no buffs, no potions. Let the monster hit you.

scenarios.title: Mage skills and debuffs (Mild)
scenarios.play: Cast Power Support and Hit Support on yourself before each pull (hotbar 5-6). Open with Mild, then Lightning Shock, Freezing Bolt, Magma Burn whenever each is ready (hotbar 1-4); auto-attack in between.
scenarios.note: Was 562 Sikuku Elite Fighter, which dies on spawn (an AI summon). 1561 Sikuku Gargoyle Hunter casts skill 3549 from its 'damaged' pattern; in the 2026-10-14 run it fired once and was interrupted by a stun, dealing nothing.

scenarios.title: Scout bow vs a magic caster
scenarios.play: Bow auto-attacks only, standing still at range. No skills, no buffs, no potions.

scenarios.title: Artisan gun: Weapon Research's critical (passive fix, 2026-10-14)
scenarios.play: Gun auto-attacks only, 6-8 kills. No skills, no buffs, no potions.
scenarios.note: Crit share of landed hits: ~89% with the server fix, ~76% on the old server (the second passive range was wiped). Needs the rebuilt sho_gameserver and LIST_SKILL from rebalance-artisan.py --profile gunsmith-v2.

scenarios.title: Monster AI: self-cast area skill that stops the monster (Goblin Sword)
scenarios.play: Auto-attack only, 8-10 kills. No skills, no buffs, no potions. Rest to full HP between pulls.
scenarios.note: bomb1.aip: each player hit has a 30% x 50% chance to make it self-cast Flame Hawk (2992, type 17, weapon damage, power 300) around itself: ~1.9 casts and ~580 damage each per fight, against 37 per normal hit. Action mode 0: it stops after the cast and turns back on the player at its next hit.

scenarios.title: Monster AI: magic area skill with a silence, then resumes (Elder Sikuku)
scenarios.play: Auto-attack only, 8-10 kills. No skills, no buffs, no potions. Rest to full HP between pulls.
scenarios.note: ed_shaman.aip: casts 3056 (type 17, magic, power 120, silences: state 30) from its 'damaged' pattern, ~2.5 casts per fight at ~410 damage; action mode 2 resumes the attack. Its 'call for help' finds nobody when spawned alone.
